thread:
Alex: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: updated the NovaHealth pilot KMS/HSM notes and demo script. Blockers: waiting on Security to confirm supported KMS algorithms and BYOK onboarding timeline. Today: follow up with SecEng + schedule a canary demo. @Maria can you drop the compliance doc link? :eyes:
Maria: Got it. I pinged Legal & Compliance — they want a KMS flow diagram, data retention SOW, and explicit key custody language. Uploading to drive now: https://redwood.app/drive/pilot-novahealth (folder). I'll loop in Jun for on‑prem install checklist.
Sam: Heads up — Eng asked for example request headers for Dedicated endpoints (token + tenant header). I added a sample to the repo and opened a PR. Need Alex to confirm the header names.
Jun: Security also asked for an HSM spec sheet: key lifecycle, algorithm list, and attestation/certificate flow. @Caroline do you have the vendor contact or a spec we can share?
Caroline: I do. Will intro shortly. Also flagged that Dedicated pilots need a short network diagram for VPC peering and allowed CIDR ranges — I'll put diagrams in the shared folder.
sec-bot: Compliance checklist updated (COMP-2026): added BYOK steps, attestation expectations, and a minimal evidence list. See doc. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks. Quick engineering ask — can Eng runtime add a config flag to suppress token-level logs for demo environments? Privacy team requires it before we show logs. Blocker until that's in. @Sam are you able to coordinate?
Sam: Yep — will open PR and tag eng-runtime. ETA EOD. Code snippet I'll include in the PR:
```
// mask sensitive headers in demo mode
logger.setMasking(true, ['authorization', 'x-api-key', 'x-tenant-id'])
```
Latency baseline looks unchanged after the change.
Maria: Scheduling the canary demo for Tue 11am PT. Invites out to Legal, SecEng, Infra, and NovaHealth. If runtime patch lands, we'll rerun internal smoke tests Mon afternoon.
Jun: One small blocker on my side — the on‑prem installer currently assumes root during package extraction. We need a non-root flow for customer infra. Eng to confirm feasibility by EOD.
Caroline: Intro email to HSM vendor sent. Vendor replied: "we support RSA, ECDSA, AES-GCM, AES-KW, HMAC-SHA2; provide FIPS module on request." Forwarding the vendor thread to SecEng.
Alex: Great. I'll update the pilot checklist with those vendor guarantees and add a risk row for 'installer privileges'. If no objections, we proceed to demo Tue.
Maria: +1. Please add SOW deliverables (diagrams + attestation docs) to the drive before EOD Mon. :thumbsup:
Sam: PR opened: #1427. CC @eng-runtime. Will post test run results in the thread when done.
Alex: Thanks all — will follow up with PM for SOW and lock calendar. If anyone hits a showstopper, ping here and I'll escalate.
